title: i3Neurons Differentiation
author: Michael S. Fernandopulle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5h6g39e
materials: Aspirate PBS and repeat once more.

steps.title: Coat dish with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL–9 mL of Matrigel solution to a new 15‑cm tissue‑culture dish, tilt to cover the entire surface, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min–1 h. Matrigel can be reused once or twice after 30‑min incubations (aspirate with a serological pipette and store at 4 °C) or kept on the plate for up to 1 week (use 10‑20 % more solution). Do not reuse Matrigel that has been at 37 °C for more than 1–2 h total.

steps.title: Prepare induction medium with doxycycline
steps.instruction: Make 20 mL of induction medium (IM) containing 2 µg mL⁻¹ doxycycline and 10 µM Y‑27632 ROCK inhibitor. Warm the medium in a 37 °C water or bead bath. Keep doxycycline protected from light and store at 4 °C when not in use.

steps.title: Assess iPSC confluency
steps.instruction: Observe the iPSC culture under a phase‑contrast microscope and confirm 70‑80 % confluency (approximately 2.5 × 10⁷–3 × 10⁷ cells).

steps.title: Wash plate with PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate spent medium with a vacuum‑connected pipette. Add 10 mL PBS to the dish by tilting and slowly dispensing against the sidewall, then tilt the dish in all directions to spread the solution. Aspirate PBS and repeat once (or until debris is absent). Observe under the microscope to confirm clearance of debris.

steps.title: Dissociate cells with Accutase
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL Accutase to the washed dish, incubate as described in Basic Protocol 1, and collect the dissociated cells together with an additional 7 mL PBS into a 15‑mL conical tube.

steps.title: Count cells and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Count the cells and transfer 2 × 10⁷–2.5 × 10⁷ iPSCs per 15‑cm dish into a conical tube (add 5 % IM to the PBS before centrifugation to improve pelleting). Centrifuge for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in induction medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL–12 mL of IM containing 2 µg mL⁻¹ doxycycline and 10 µM Y‑27632.

steps.title: Plate cells onto coated dish
steps.instruction: Aspirate the Matrigel solution from the coated dish (or transfer it to a fresh dish if newly coated). Gently pipette the cell suspension onto the dish. Rinse the 15‑mL tube with an additional 8 mL IM (same composition) and add the rinse to the dish so that the total volume is 18 mL–20 mL. Tilt the dish in all directions to distribute cells evenly.

steps.title: Verify cell distribution and viability
steps.instruction: Examine the dish under a microscope to ensure even cell distribution and a high proportion of live cells (identified by a light halo) versus dead cells or debris.

steps.title: Incubate and evenly distribute cells
steps.instruction: Place the dish in a 37 °C incubator and gently slide it side‑to‑side and front‑to‑back to further spread the cells.

steps.title: Check for early neurite outgrowth
steps.instruction: After approximately 24 h of doxycycline exposure, inspect the cells; nascent neuritic extensions should be visible.

steps.title: Prepare IM without ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Make 20 mL of IM containing 2 µg mL⁻¹ doxycycline (no Y‑27632). Warm in a 37 °C water/bead bath for about 20 min (or until warm to the touch).

steps.title: Replace medium with fresh IM
steps.instruction: Aspirate the old medium, wash the dish 1–2 times with PBS, and add 18 mL of the warm IM (+ doxycycline). If significant debris is observed, perform additional PBS washes before adding fresh medium.

steps.title: Monitor neurite development
steps.instruction: Observe the cells; neuritic extensions should become more evident after each medium change.

steps.title: Repeat daily medium exchanges
steps.instruction: Each day, repeat the medium‑exchange procedure described in steps 12–14 (prepare IM without ROCK inhibitor, wash with PBS, add fresh IM with doxycycline) until robust neurite networks are established.

steps.title: Troubleshoot unhealthy cultures
steps.instruction: If neurites are absent or cells appear misshapen/unhealthy, discard the culture and restart the protocol with a fresh batch of day‑0 iPSCs. Prepare new IM containing fresh doxycycline and ROCK inhibitor.

steps.title: Dissociate and freeze or re‑plate cells
steps.instruction: When cells are healthy and neurites are established, dissociate them with Accutase following steps 3–8 of Day 0. Then either freeze the cells as described in Basic Protocol 1 or re‑plate onto final dishes for neuronal maturation (see Basic Protocol 6).

steps.title: Coat new dish for re‑plating
steps.instruction: If re‑plating for maturation, coat a new 15‑cm dish with 7 mL–9 mL Matrigel, tilt to cover, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min–1 h before plating the dissociated cells.
